system.description:
Every dawn, you can attune yourself to the realm of spirits for a brief moment. During this time, you can agree to let a Warden Spirit invert your flow of mana so that it only flows inwards, reinforcing the body at a cost. This effect lasts for 24 hours.

Restrictions while active:

  • Cannot access or use any Mortal or Immortal Aspects.
  • Cannot activate items or equipment that require expending Mana.
  • Mana can only be used to convert to Stamina.
  • Unarmed attacks do no harm to monsters — only Reverence Steel weapons or damage-dealing equipment work.

Benefits while active:

  • Maximum Movement +4.
  • Maximum Mana reduced by half.
  • Maximum Health +Level.
  • Arcane Sense becomes 0 and cannot be rolled.
  • All Senses except Arcane raise by 2 (can exceed 5, max 7).
  • All Physical Talents raise by 4 (can exceed 5, max 7).
  • Physical Resistance rolls +2.
  • Magykal Resistance rolls -5.
  • Cannot be detected by Arcane Sense.
  • Gain Expertise in all forms of movement (if not already possessed).
  • Falling, collision, and crashing damage is halved.
  • 2 Damage Reduction from all damage types except Ahl.
system.other_restrictions: Daily — activated at dawn; lasts 24 hours
